sqlite.name: exercise_sessions
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE exercise_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	max_sends INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	terminated_at DATETIME, 
	terminated_by INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_max_sends CHECK (max_sends >= 1 AND max_sends <= 50), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(terminated_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

sqlite.name: exercise_deliveries
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE exercise_deliveries (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	requested_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	message_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	trigger_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(40), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	attempted_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_exercise_idempotency UNIQUE (session_id, idempotency_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_type CHECK (message_type = 'EXERCISE_TEST'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_trigger CHECK (trigger_kind = 'manual'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_exercise_state CHECK (state IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','TESTED','SENT','REJECTED','SUPPRESSED','UNKNOWN')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES exercise_sessions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES notification_devices (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(requested_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
